# Endocrinology Advisor

> A comprehensive clinical resource for endocrinologists and healthcare providers covering diabetes management, thyroid disorders, bone metabolism, and hormonal conditions with evidence-based guidance and case studies.

Endocrinology Advisor provides expert clinical content including research summaries, clinical guidelines, case challenges, and professional perspectives on endocrine disorders. The site features contributions from leading endocrinologists and references major clinical trials and professional organizations like the American Diabetes Association.

## Key Topics

- Type 2 Diabetes
- Clinical Guidelines
- Diabetes Management
- Thyroid Disorders
- Bone Metabolism
- GLP-1 Receptor Agonists
- Glycemic Control
- Osteoporosis
- Hyperparathyroidism
- Clinical Trials
- Cushing Syndrome
- Cortisol
- Parathyroid Hormone (PTH)
- Diabetes Prevention
- Maternal Health

## Diabetes Management & Treatment

- [Oral Semaglutide CV Benefits More Pronounced at Higher HbA1c in T2D](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/reports/oral-semaglutide-cv-benefits-more-pronounced-at-higher-hba1c-in-t2d): Clinical trial analysis of oral semaglutide cardiovascular benefits by HbA1c levels
- [Meta-Analysis Compares Cardiometabolic Effects, Safety of Once-Weekly GLP-1 Receptor Agonists](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/features/meta-analysis-compares-cardiometabolic-effects-safety-of-once-weekly-glp-1-receptor-agonists): Comparative meta-analysis of GLP-1 receptor agonists cardiometabolic safety profiles
- [Intensive Glycemic Therapy Slows Neurodegeneration in Diabetes](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/diabetes/type-2-diabetes/intensive-glycemic-therapy-slows-neurodegeneration-in-diabetes): ACCORD-MIND trial findings on intensive glycemic control and brain gray matter preservation
- [Smoking Linked to Increased Diabetes Risk](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/diabetes/type-2-diabetes/smoking-linked-to-increased-diabetes-risk): Research findings on smoking as a risk factor for type 2 diabetes development
- [New Predictors of Type 2 Diabetes in Native Americans](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/diabetes/type-2-diabetes/new-predictors-of-type-2-diabetes-in-native-americans): Research on metabolic markers predicting type 2 diabetes in Native American populations
- [Diabetes and Driving: A Statement of the American Diabetes Association](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/pri/diabetes-and-driving-a-statement-of-the-american-diabetes-association): ADA clinical statement on diabetes management and driving safety guidelines
- [Diabetes, Ramadan, and Driving: Ensuring Patient Safety While Respecting Religious Autonomy](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/features/legal-and-religious-considerations-for-diabetes-care-during-ramadan): Clinical guidance for diabetes management during Ramadan fasting with safety protocols

## Bone & Mineral Metabolism

- [Primary Hyperparathyroidism: Diagnosis and Management](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/features/primary-hyperparathyroidism-diagnosis-and-management): Clinical guidelines on primary hyperparathyroidism diagnosis and asymptomatic management
- [Managing Osteoporosis With Type 2 Diabetes: An Expert Opinion](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/features/managing-osteoporosis-with-type-2-diabetes-an-expert-opinion): Expert guidance on managing osteoporosis in type 2 diabetes patients via systematic review
- [Higher Fat and Appendicular Lean Masses May Protect Against Menopausal BMD Loss](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/reports/higher-fat-appendicular-lean-masses-may-protect-against-menopausal-bmd-loss): Clinical study on bone mineral density loss protection in postmenopausal women
- [Dementia Linked to Parathyroid Hormone](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/bone-metabolism/dementia-linked-to-parathyroid-hormone): Research on parathyroid hormone elevation and vascular dementia development

## Thyroid & Endocrine Disorders

- [Providing Optimal Care for Patients With Thyroid Nodules](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/thyroid/providing-optimal-care-for-patients-with-thyroid-nodules): Dr. Kloos discusses thyroid nodule diagnosis technologies and fine needle aspiration methods
- [Cushing Syndrome in Pregnancy: When to Suspect and How to Treat](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/features/cushing-syndrome-in-pregnancy-when-to-suspect-and-how-to-treat): Clinical guidance on diagnosing and managing Cushing syndrome in pregnant patients
- [Gout](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/ddi/gout): Comprehensive reference on gout epidemiology, diagnosis, and clinical management

## Pregnancy & Maternal Health

- [Poverty During Pregnancy Hikes Cortisol Levels in Mother and Fetus](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/adrenal/poverty-during-pregnancy-hikes-cortisol-levels-in-mother-and-fetus): Research linking poverty-related stress and elevated cortisol in pregnancy outcomes

## Obesity & Weight Management

- [Strategies to Prevent Obesity in Children](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/features/strategies-to-prevent-obesity-in-children): Evidence-based strategies for childhood obesity prevention and weight management
- [Text Messages and Financial Incentives Boost Weight Loss at 12 Months](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/healthday/text-messages-and-financial-incentives-boost-weight-loss-at-12-months): Clinical trial results on behavioral interventions for weight loss in obese men

## Public Health & Prevention

- [National Diabetes Prevention Program Offers Model for Combating Diabetes Epidemic](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/conference-highlights/aade-2015/national-diabetes-prevention-program-offers-model-for-combating-diabetes-epidemic): CDC diabetes prevention program components and public health approach overview

- [Case Challenge: Painless, Erythematous Rash on the Lower Extremities](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/diabetes/case-challenge-painless-erythematous-rash-on-the-lower-extremities): Clinical case challenge on differential diagnosis of lower extremity rash presentation
- [Endocrinologist Offers Concrete Guidance on Mentoring Clinical Trainees](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/general-endocrinology/endocrinologist-offers-concrete-guidance-on-mentoring-clinical-trainees): Professional perspective on mentoring medical students and clinical trainee development
